name: Chip
description: Pill control for filtering, multi-select, and removable tags.

variant.description: Chrome family. soft is the tinted pill; outline is hairline-bordered on the page surface

tone.description: Semantic colour from the shared tone ramp. neutral is ink on the neutral surfaces; the others tint, border and ink from one derivation shared with Badge and Button

selected.description: Whether the chip is in a selected state

icon.description: Icon element rendered before the label

avatar.description: Avatar element rendered before the label

onRemove.description: Makes chip removable. Called when X is clicked.

value.description: Value identifier used by Chip.Group for selection tracking

when: Filtering a list by tag or category
Showing filters the user can dismiss
whenNot: A main call to action — use Button
guidelines: One to three words per chip
Chip.Group when chips share selection state
Keep xs for filters and tags; size up only to match a taller control track
onRemove only when the chip is genuinely dismissible
Pass an explicit value when children are custom JSX
Tone only when the chip reports a state; a plain filter stays neutral
accessibility: Chips are buttons; selection is reported via aria-pressed
Add role and aria-label to Chip.Group when the set needs a name
Remove buttons carry the chip text in their aria-label
Disabled chips are skipped by keyboard and pointer

examples.name: Variants
examples.description: Soft is the tinted pill; outline sits on the page surface.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Chip>Soft</Chip>
  <Chip variant="outline">Outline</Chip>
</Stack>

examples.name: Tones
examples.description: The same ramp Badge and Button use, in both variants.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="column" gap="sm">
  <Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
    <Chip tone="accent">Accent</Chip>
    <Chip tone="info">Info</Chip>
    <Chip tone="success">Success</Chip>
    <Chip tone="warning">Warning</Chip>
    <Chip tone="danger">Danger</Chip>
  </Stack>
  <Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
    <Chip variant="outline" tone="accent">Accent</Chip>
    <Chip variant="outline" tone="info">Info</Chip>
    <Chip variant="outline" tone="success">Success</Chip>
    <Chip variant="outline" tone="warning">Warning</Chip>
    <Chip variant="outline" tone="danger">Danger</Chip>
  </Stack>
</Stack>

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: xs for filter rows; larger sizes match taller field tracks.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center" wrap>
  <Chip variant="outline" size="xs">Extra small</Chip>
  <Chip variant="outline" size="sm">Small</Chip>
  <Chip variant="outline" size="md">Medium</Chip>
  <Chip variant="outline" size="lg">Large</Chip>
</Stack>

examples.name: Selected
examples.description: Both variants share one selection treatment.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Chip selected>Soft</Chip>
  <Chip variant="outline" selected>Outline</Chip>
</Stack>

examples.name: With Remove
examples.description: Trailing dismiss button clears the tag.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Chip variant="outline" onRemove={() => {}}>React</Chip>
  <Chip variant="outline" selected onRemove={() => {}}>TypeScript</Chip>
  <Chip tone="info" onRemove={() => {}}>SCSS</Chip>
</Stack>

examples.name: Chip Group
examples.description: Selection state is held by the group, not each chip.

examples.name: Chip Group with Custom Labels
examples.description: Custom JSX children need an explicit value.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Dimmed and unreachable, selected or not.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Chip variant="outline" disabled>Disabled</Chip>
  <Chip variant="outline" disabled selected>Disabled selected</Chip>
</Stack>

relations.note: Badge is display-only; Chip is interactive
Use ToggleGroup for mutually exclusive options
Use Button for primary actions, Chip for selection/filtering

propsSummary: variant: soft|outline - chrome family (soft by default)
tone: neutral|accent|info|success|warning|danger - shared tone ramp (neutral by default)
size: xs|sm|md|lg - chip size (xs by default)
Chip.Group forwards DOM props (id, role, aria-*, data-*, handlers)
Chip.Group: non-string chip labels should set an explicit value
